      "text": "{{ing_01|Boneless pieces of anchovies or [other small] fish}}, either roast [fried] boiled, chop very fine. Fill a casserole generously with the same [season with] {{ing_02|crushed pepper}} and {{ing_03|a little rue}}, add {{ing_04|sufficient broth}} and {{ing_05|some oil}}, and mix in, also add {{ing_06|enough raw eggs}} so that the whole forms one solid mass."
